A000.visual_assessment: Baseline: continuous broad ribs, but fine articulation is faint already before CC. Terminal smoothing adds density without a clear whole-gate design gain. Shaded and wireframe raw/CC crops were inspected.

terminal_surface_metrics.boundary_policy: Fix existing naked-boundary vertices; crease only naked-boundary edges at 2; k=1.

B000.visual_assessment: Baseline: four dense crown/shoulder clusters with perimeter fins. Interiors still read as tiled cells. Narrow, pinched-looking fan junctions are visible in the shaded/wireframe crops; the sampled transverse check does not settle their clearance.

C000.visual_assessment: Baseline: diagonal hierarchy and quiet regions are visible, with grid-stepped edges and repeated nested caps. Local angular detail does not form a continuous ridge across the original face grid.
